lines: COMMITS on track/p-payout-reference (not pushed, rebased or landed): 1e89881 feat(payouts): make the payout bank transfer reference optional (server, contract, migration 074, first panel); e30bdef feat(payouts): stop asking for or showing the transfer reference (DEC-69 follow-up: panel, held-write notice label, frontend tests, DEPLOY.md).

DEC-69 (e30bdef): WithdrawalPayoutPanel.tsx has no reference input. Paid is a plain confirm, 'This records that the transfer has completed.', with no reference row. Failed is unchanged and still requires its failure code; the confirm keeps its Failure code row. The card shows the header 'Fund · withdrawal date · paid' and nothing else for paid, so a reference stored by a released admin app is never shown. Pending still reads 'Awaiting transfer confirmation' and failed 'Failure code: X'. The new build never puts transferReference in a request it composes. HeldWriteNotice.tsx drops the transferReference field label (owned by features/admin/shared, edited at the coordinator's request).

HELD BODIES FROM THE PREVIOUS BUILD: parsePayoutUpdate uses the contract, where transferReference is optional, so a hold carrying a reference still reads (no 'Held request not readable'). Check again resends it unchanged with the same Idempotency-Key, as rule 6 requires; stripping it would change the request hash. This is the only path that can still send a reference from the new build, and only for a hold the previous build created.

PAID DATE: the brief asked for the paid date on the card. AdminWithdrawalPayout has no paid date, only effectiveDate (the withdrawal date, already in the header), and a new response key breaks released apps (finding-14). So the card keeps the existing header; showing paid_at needs a new endpoint (not done).

SERVER/CONTRACT unchanged from 1e89881: the request transferReference is optional; absent, empty or blank stores NULL; a sent one is trimmed and stored; the response keeps the key (null or the stored value). Migration 074 relaxes withdrawal_operations_shape so a paid row may have no reference, never a blank one; it is expand-only. releaseUpgrade expects 074.

COMPAT (rule 11, finding-14): released admin apps (v0.15.4..v0.18.0) declare transferReference z.string().nullable() in a strict object in every state, so null parses. Those builds show 'Awaiting transfer confirmation' under '· paid' for a payout paid without a reference, with the form hidden, so nothing can be recorded twice.

ROLLBACK (DEPLOY.md 074 note, review-44 LOW-3): (a) the new admin APK against a backend from before 074 (v0.17.0 or v0.18.0) is refused 400 VALIDATION_FAILED on every Paid and writes nothing; mark payouts paid from the rolled-back admin web or an older admin APK until roll-forward; (b) a held payout body saved by the new admin web has no reference, so a rolled-back v0.18.0 admin web shows 'Held request not readable' (v0.17.0 has no held writes and ignores it).

BACKEND TESTS (1e89881, kept): maturitySettlement.integration.test.ts 'optional payout transfer reference': left out / empty / blank store NULL and audit null; a sent reference is stored trimmed and an over-long one refused; a payout paid without a reference parses under a frozen copy of the released admin payout list schema. payoutReferenceMigration.integration.test.ts: 074 populated upgrade and the new check. Reds: 60bff648, 8a35e74a, ba9621b0, 1761cf23.

FRONTEND TESTS (e30bdef) in heldMoneyWrites.test.tsx: the payout held-write case no longer types a reference (locked control: Transfer outcome). New describe 'a payout outcome without a bank transfer reference': (1) no reference input, the confirm text, Paid sends exactly {state:'paid', expectedVersion:1} with no transferReference key, and a paid payout with a stored 'BANK-OLD-1' shows '· paid' with no reference text; (2) a paid hold saved with transferReference reads as 'Not confirmed', shows no reference, and Check again resends the same key and the same body.

FRONTEND RED CONTROLS (restored, cmp identical, tree clean after): b1e6b923 the 1e89881 panel put back fails test (1) at the reference input; 21d6a6e4 parsePayoutUpdate stripping the reference from a paid hold fails test (2) on body equality.

GREEN CHECKS on e30bdef, clean tree, Node 24 container: frontend npm ci + check bb92d0f5 (46 files, 449 tests); build:client 058433fe (android dist 17 assets 954710 bytes, boot check); build:admin bef3484d (boot check). Contracts and backend unchanged since 1e89881: 8eb76c21 (contracts, 98), 09510f26 (backend check, 1204), 3be6d95f (integration, 74 files, 596).

RUNTIME STEPS (not run after e30bdef): admin web, Client values, a client with a pending maturity or SIP early-exit payout. Outcome Paid shows no second field; Record transfer outcome opens 'Mark payout paid?' with 'This records that the transfer has completed.' and no reference row; Mark paid sends {state:'paid', expectedVersion:N} (network tab: no transferReference); the card shows '· paid' only. A payout already paid with a reference also shows no reference. Outcome Failed still needs a failure code. The DB row is paid with transfer_reference NULL.

LEFT: the plan section 8 entry (coordinator, rule-50). Migration number 074 must be renumbered by whichever lane lands second if another 0.18.x lane also adds 074 (the file, the test's MIGRATION constant, the releaseUpgrade list, the DEPLOY.md note). client-erasure.md's 'releaseUpgrade expects' line not touched (owned by p-erasure-phones).
COMMIT: 1e89881 feat(payouts): make the payout bank transfer reference optional (one commit on track/p-payout-reference; not pushed, rebased or landed).

WHERE THE REFERENCE LIVES (all checked): request contract admin-maturity.ts AdminPayoutStatusBody; route schema adminMaturitySchemas.ts + adminMaturityRoutes.ts updatePayout; domain withdrawalPayout.ts; column withdrawal_operations.transfer_reference (nullable since 051, but 051's withdrawal_operations_shape check required a non-blank one for paid); reads listAdminWithdrawalPayouts and the admin SIP early-exit payout object (both AdminWithdrawalPayout, earlyExitProjection.ts); admin screen WithdrawalPayoutPanel.tsx (used by MaturityPanel and SipEarlyExitList) and the HeldWriteNotice field label; audit metadata of withdrawal_payout.paid (audit trail screen does not show metadata). Not present: client APIs/screens (mapClientSipEarlyExit has none), notifications, emails, statements, accounting/CSV exports. Erasure keeps it (exempt), unchanged.

CHANGED: contract and route: paid transferReference is z.string().trim().max(200).optional(); recordedTransferReference() maps absent, empty or blank to null, a sent one is trimmed and stored as before. Domain accepts null for paid, still refuses a blank or >256 string. Repository markPayoutPaid takes string|null. Generated OpenAPI regenerated (frontend src/api/generated unchanged).

MIGRATION 074_optional_payout_reference.sql: drops and re-adds withdrawal_operations_shape; paid may hold a NULL reference, never a blank one; pending and failed rules unchanged. Expand-only (looser check, every existing row satisfies it). releaseUpgrade expected list now ends 073, 074. DEPLOY.md rollback section has a 074 note.

ADMIN PANEL: field 'Bank transfer reference (optional)', required only for Failed; empty sends no key; card line is 'Awaiting transfer confirmation' (pending), 'Bank transfer reference: X' or 'Bank transfer reference: Not recorded' (paid), 'Failure code: X' (failed); confirm adds a 'Bank transfer reference' row ('Not recorded' when empty) or a 'Failure code' row, and the paid description drops the reference sentence when empty.

COMPAT (rule 11, finding-14): request side: released admin apps always send a non-empty reference; still accepted, same hash, same stored value. Read side: v0.15.4 and v0.18.0 contracts (git show) both declare AdminWithdrawalPayout.transferReference z.string().nullable() in any state inside a strictObject, so the server keeps the key and sends null; omitting the key or adding a field would fail their strict parse. A placeholder string was rejected: it would put an invented value in a data field (rule 7) and an images-only rollback sends null anyway.

COMPAT LIMIT (STATIC, git show of v0.15.4/v0.17.1/v0.18.0 panel): those admin builds render transferReference ?? failureCode ?? 'Awaiting transfer confirmation', so a payout paid without a reference shows 'Awaiting transfer confirmation' under the header '... · paid'. They hide the outcome form once the payout is not pending, so nothing can be recorded twice. Admin web is current after deploy; only older admin APKs show it until updated (minimumSupportedVersion is the maintainer's call).

ROLLBACK: previous release (v0.18.0 image) runs against 074 unchanged: still requires a reference on writes, reads null fine. A new admin APK against a rolled-back backend gets 400 VALIDATION_FAILED for an empty reference (explicit refusal; entering one works).

TESTS (rule 10): maturitySettlement.integration.test.ts describe 'optional payout transfer reference': (1) test.each left out / empty / blank -> 200, row paid with transfer_reference NULL, version 1, audit metadata transferReference null; (2) a sent '  BANK-TEST-456 ' stored trimmed + audited, 201 chars refused 400 with the payout still pending; (3) list response for a payout paid without a reference parses under a frozen copy of the released (v0.15.4 = v0.18.0) admin payout list schema. payoutReferenceMigration.integration.test.ts: 074 populated upgrade (pending, paid-with-reference, failed rows byte-identical) and the new check (null ok for paid; blank, reference on pending/failed, paid without paid_at refused).

RED CONTROLS (each mutation restored, cmp identical, tree clean after): 60bff648 migration 074 re-adds the strict check -> 5 failed (3 absent cases 500, list parse, migration check test); 8a35e74a route schema requires the reference -> 4 failed (400 VALIDATION_FAILED); ba9621b0 route drops a sent reference -> 1 failed (the as-before test; the old BANK-TEST-123 test does not assert the stored value); 1761cf23 list omits a null transferReference key -> 1 failed (released-schema ZodError).

GREEN CHECKS on 1e89881, clean tree, Node 24 container: contracts npm ci + build + check 8eb76c21 (98 tests); backend npm ci + check 09510f26 (101 files, 1204 tests, unit coverage lines 81.85%); backend test:integration --coverage.enabled=false 3be6d95f (74 files, 596 tests); frontend npm ci + check 11ddbe96 (46 files, 447 tests); build:client 31bb85b2 (android dist 17 assets 954710 bytes, boot check); build:admin d38863f1 (boot check).

RUNTIME STEPS (UNVERIFIED, no browser run here): local stack, admin web, Client values for a client with a pending maturity or SIP early-exit payout. Choose Paid, leave the reference empty: button enabled; confirm shows 'Bank transfer reference: Not recorded' and 'Confirm that the transfer has completed.'; Mark paid; the card shows '· paid' and 'Bank transfer reference: Not recorded'; withdrawal_operations row is paid with transfer_reference NULL. Repeat with 'BANK-1': stored and shown. API: POST /v1/admin/clients/{userId}/withdrawal-payouts/{payoutId}/status {state:paid, expectedVersion:0} -> 200; GET .../withdrawal-payouts -> item transferReference null. Optional: a v0.18.0 admin build shows 'Awaiting transfer confirmation' for it, with no form.

DOUBT 1: docs/ui-overhaul/plan.md UQ-2 row recommends 'the form field removed'; the brief and DEC-61's tally text say 'optional'. Built optional per the brief. If the maintainer meant removal, a follow-up deletes the input; the server already accepts absence.

DOUBT 2: migration number 074 may collide with another 0.18.x lane (p-erasure-phones touches backend_controller/db). Whoever lands second renumbers the file, the test's MIGRATION constant, the releaseUpgrade list and the DEPLOY.md note.

LEFT: plan section 8 entry (coordinator, rule-50); client-erasure.md's 'releaseUpgrade expects' line not touched (p-erasure-phones owns that file); no domain unit test added (integration covers the domain with a real database).
